Q1: This issue's heal scope marker (`<!-- ai:workflow-heal-scope:v1 paths=.github/workflows/plan.yml,tests/**,changelog.d/*.md ... -->`) covers only `plan.yml`, tests and changelog fragments. Implement preflight enforces that marker on `ai:workflow-heal` issues, so options B and C would be held at plan approval or blocked at implement. B and C also wait on a maintainer editing the issue body, and that is the kind of circular dependency the pipeline has to avoid. Option A fixes the actual failure from the report: plan exits 1 on a `label_missing` refusal it already knows to be deterministic, and that exit files the `plan_failed` heal report. With the fix, each judge round on a held item ends quietly in the same hold clarify uses, and other exit-3 reasons still fail closed. The change to the judge's `/answer` loop in `scripts/unblock_actions.py` goes to a separate follow-up issue, as option A says.
